title: TRADING IS ON THE LEGENDS
why: His note of 2026-10-03: trading instructions are not even on the key legend. The full key list and the full pad list gain a TEAM section (T or Y: offer or take a traded item; N or both bumpers: ping). While a party is on, the compact legend gains the same two rows and grows for them. The stash key bar says RIGHT CLICK offers to your teammate when the windows are linked, and the Party window explains both ways to trade in two sentences.
now: Trading is on every key legend now, the stash key bar says how to offer, and the Party window explains both ways to trade.
